article.title: Firmo Por Cuba: Global Campaign of Signature Collection
article.author: admin
article.content: We invite every trade union and mass organization, every activist and friend of Cuba in every country of the world to take part and organize the Global Campaign for Signature collection: “Cuba is not alone! No to new war!” #firmoporcuba #cubanoestasola Steps for the Global Campaign “Firmo Por Cuba – Sign for Cuba”: 1. Download and print the form! 2. Collect signatures in your workplace, your community, your country! 3. Deliver them at the Embassy of Cuba! 4. Send an email with the number of the signatures you collected at: contact@firmoporcuba.com 5. Share the global online form: https://www.firmoporcuba.com/ The post Firmo Por Cuba: Global Campaign of Signature Collection appeared first on theory and praxis .
